description: This file implements a dead code elimination (DCE) pass for unused extra outputs in higher-order subgraphs within the PyTorch FX graph framework. It identifies and removes unused outputs from subgraphs related to HOP operations like invoke_subgraph and tag_activation_checkpoint, updating call sites accordingly.

methods.name: dce_hop_extra_outputs
methods.description: Removes unused extra outputs from HOP calls in all submodules of a given GraphModule, returning True if modifications were made.

methods.name: _collect_all_subgraph_usages
methods.description: Recursively collects all HOP subgraph usages across the graph tree, mapping subgraph IDs to their callers.

methods.name: _is_output_used
methods.description: Checks if a specific output index is used by any caller (via getitem with users).

methods.name: _dce_subgraph
methods.description: Performs dead code elimination on a subgraph by removing unused output indices, updating call sites and metadata, and recompiling graphs.
